s.n: Desk pop smoked salmon bagel bites
s.note: the paperwork desk where Allen is happiest
s.how: Slice 1 red onion thin and cover with 80ml white vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt for 20 minutes. Beat 200g cream cheese with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped dill and lemon zest. Split and toast 8 mini bagels. Spread each half with the cream cheese, fold on smoked salmon (200g total), top with drained pickled onion and dill and grind over pepper.

s.note: Terry wants to be a peacock, so let him fly
s.how: Mix 150g chickpea flour, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chilli, salt and 180ml water into a batter. Stir in 2 sliced onions and 100g chopped spinach. Fry spoonfuls at 180C for 4 minutes and serve with 200g yoghurt mixed with mint.

m.n: Lion versus tuna sesame tuna bowls
m.note: Allen's theory on who wins, a lion or a tuna
m.how: Cook 2 cups sushi rice and season with 3 tbsp rice vinegar and 1 tbsp sugar. Coat 4 tuna steaks (600g) in 60g mixed sesame seeds. Sear in a very hot oiled pan 45 seconds a side and slice. Whisk 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil and half a tsp wasabi. Boil 200g frozen edamame 3 minutes. Build bowls with rice, tuna, sliced avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger and spoon over the dressing.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 180g butter. Whisk in 300g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 170C for 28 minutes and cool before cutting.

d.note: Gator, the alter ego Allen would rather forget
d.how: For each drink, put 50ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 20ml sugar syrup and half an egg white (2 egg whites total) in a shaker. Shake without ice for 10 seconds to build the foam, then add ice and shake hard for 10 seconds more. Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass. Add 3 drops of aromatic bitters on the foam and a cherry. For non-drinkers, swap the bourbon for cold black tea.
